intent: A fresh adult summer fashion portrait in the Azure Summer style, with explicitly defined natural body proportions and a gently sensual fitted outfit. An original 30-year-old woman turns back to smile at her companion as she waits on the harbor steps.

subjects.description: Original 30-year-old adult woman with a naturally curvy, proportionate figure: medium-full bust, a clearly defined waist, softly rounded hips and realistic shoulders and ribcage.
appearance: Long blue-black hair in a loose side ponytail, a small ivory flower clip; softly defined brown eyeliner and rose lips; warm natural skin texture.

An opaque navy summer dress with a softly curved square neckline showing the collarbones and a modest area of upper chest; a shaped supportive bodice with subtle bust darts and curved princess seams, fitted waist and hip-skimming skirt.
A light white cotton overshirt worn open and loose around the shoulders, leaving the dress silhouette visible; fine pale-blue piping and a single small brass fastening.
subjects.action: Turns three-quarter toward her companion, weight resting naturally on one leg, one hand loosely holds the stair railing.

scene.summary: Camera at chest level, 65mm portrait perspective, framed from mid-thigh to just above the head so face, bust-to-waist relationship and hip silhouette remain visible. She looks just beside the lens with a relaxed confident smile. Bright blue sea and a pale stone harbor terrace behind, one softly blurred sailboat and a near white railing. Gentle canopy fill balances a bright summer backlight, highlights limited to water and individual hair strands. The atmosphere is intimate and lightly flirtatious, with realistic body volume and cloth support; no exaggeration of anatomy.
